bio: Haley Potter is a Chemical Engineering and MBA student at the University of Cincinnati, where she was selected as one of just 14 students nationwide for the NEXT Innovation Scholars program — the only incoming high school graduate chosen that year — conducting strategic foresight research for corporate and university partners. She has since built hands-on technical and leadership experience as a Manufacturing Operations Co-op at SABIC and as a Peer Leader mentoring first-year engineering students through weekly lessons and one-on-one guidance. Driven by a lifelong-learning mindset and a passion for innovative thinking, she pairs technical skills in polymer chemistry, data analysis, and SAP MM with a genuine curiosity for the people and ideas around her.
